𝐓𝐈𝐍𝐆𝐍𝐀𝐍: Ngayong Setyembre 19, 2025, pormal na nakipagkita at nakipagpulong ang ating Kura Paroko at Rektor, Rev. Fr. Ramon Jade Licuanan, kasama sina Rev. Fr. Jonathan Mojica (Parochial Vicar), at ang Fiesta Secretariat sa Chairman ng Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA), Atty. Romando S. Artes.

Kasama rin sa ginanap na pagpupulong sina MMDA Traffic Enforcement Group Director III Atty. Victor Maria Nuñez at Mr. Edward C. Gonzales, Head ng Road Emergency Group (REG), sa bagong MMDA Headquarters sa Ortigas bilang bahagi ng paghahanda para sa nalalapit na Nazareno 2026.

Nagkaroon din ng pagkakataon ang grupo na makapasyal sa mas pinalakas na MMDA Command Center, na higit pang magpapatibay ng koordinasyon para sa isang ligtas, maayos at banal na pagdiriwang ng ating kapistahan sa Enero.

Taos-pusong nagpapasalamat ang Quiapo Church team sa pamunuan ng MMDA sa kanilang mainit na pagtanggap at patuloy na pagsuporta para sa debosyon sa ating Mahal na Poong Hesus Nazareno.

data.raw_text: The US Embassy in Manila has issued an alert to all US citizens in the Metro Manila area advising them of planned protests in the area. We don't see these too often, so I presume they must believe the protest will be quite large. Popular sentiment right now is anger over allegations of widespread corruption in public works projects. I believe there is a possibility that protests could reflect that anger- leaving a likelihood of some potential for violence. I would recommend avoiding protests for US citizens out of an abundance of caution given that there have been other similar protests occurring throughout Asia this summer where protestors have been killed. Still, this sounds like it could be a historic event. Be safe and be careful out there

LOOK: Nagbabala ang U.S. Embassy sa kanilang mga mamamayan sa Pilipinas kaugnay ng mga nakatakdang protesta laban sa korapsyon sa Linggo, Setyembre 21, 2025, kasabay ng anibersaryo ng martial law declaration. | DZRH News

"Numerous protests responding to allegations of government corruption are planned in Metro Manila for Sunday, September 21, 2025, to coincide with the 53rd anniversary of the declaration of martial law by former President Ferdinand Marcos Sr. A broad coalition of students, church groups, civil society organizations, labor unions, and political coalitions are expected to join the demonstrations.
 
Locations include, but may not be limited to: 
•⁠  ⁠Rizal Park (Luneta) in Manila at 9:00 a.m.
•⁠  ⁠People Power Monument, EDSA, Quezon City at 2:00 p.m.
 
Actions to Take: 
•⁠  ⁠U.S. citizens should avoid these demonstrations due to the potential for violence.
•⁠  ⁠Follow local media and government sources for updates on possible disruptions due to protest activity.
•⁠  ⁠Exercise caution when in the vicinity of any large gatherings, as even peaceful demonstrations have the potential to turn violent without warning. Follow instructions from local authorities". — @USEmbassyPH 

📷:  U.S. Embassy in the Philippines/X
